title: Zesty Light Irish Bresaola Flatbread
description: A light and flaky Irish flatbread featuring bresaola, perfect for a high-protein snack or light lunch, with a zesty and slightly bitter flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender or fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead it a few times until it comes together.
Roll the dough out into a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Top the dough with the bresaola slices, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the arugula and parmesan cheese over the bresaola.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil over the top.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the bresaola is heated through.
